system.description:
When you react to an attack, your acrobatics training improves your mobility.

Prerequisites: Dexterity 13, Dodge, Mobility, Skill Focus (Acrobatics)

Effect: Once per encounter, as a Reaction, if a melee attack misses you, you can immediately move into an adjacent square without provoking an Attack of Opportunity.

Special: You must be aware of the attacker to benefit from this Feat. You can use this Feat a second time during the encounter by spending a Force Point.

prerequisite.text: Dexterity 13, Dodge feat, Mobility feat, and Skill Focus (Acrobatics)
